Espionage is supposed to be a secretive business, and spies are supposed to be virtually invisible. That hasn’t been the case for Alice Huang, the mysterious Shanghai executive who formed a romantic relationship with Jensen Huang, the founder of Nvidia, one of America’s most powerful tech companies. Many questions have arisen since it emerged that US intelligence believes that Huang (no relation of Jensen’s) is an asset recruited by the Chinese intelligence services to spy on behalf of Beijing. This morning’s newsletter explains what we know about the story, and what it tells us about the effectiveness of Chinese espionage. That’s after the headlines. signals.title: Show HN: Lynx – open-source fully-customizable AI workspace
signals.summary: I was finding that managing multiple agent threads with walls of text was getting tiring and inefficient for me and that I wanted a more visual way to interact with my agents, so I built Lynx. Lynx lets you quickly build fully custom interfaces connected to your data sources (e.g. via MCP or API) and trigger agents running on your machine from them (e.g. with Claude Code or Codex). I built it as an experiment but have found myself doing 80-90% of my work from inside Lynx. I have my own Conductor-like workspace for coding, a Mail client, a workspace for my writing, and various others for dashboards and explorations. signals.summary: I’ve had acne for 10 years and I'm so exhausted of dont know what happened. Instead of tracking your skin or logging daily habits, you can just talk or interact with it like a companion. You can share about your acne, share your concerns, or ask anything you want. Based on what you share, it uses Al to reasoning to make guesses about what could be causing your acne. As you share more, it update it understanding abt you, its guesses abt the cause and it suggestions. This is an early version, and there's still a lot to improve. I'd love to hear your feedback! signals.summary: I am struggling to see the benefit of basing your startup in SF if you are not a frontier AI lab? Because of this, I could probably get more bang for my buck starting my company in another tech hub, such as LA, London, Berlin or Tallinn? evidence.summary: Tổng giám đốc Krungsri đánh giá Việt Nam là một trong những nền kinh tế năng động, nhiều triển vọng nhất ASEAN, đồng thời khẳng định cam kết đầu tư dài hạn tại Việt Nam thông qua SFinance.

evidence.title: Hà Nội dự kiến điều chuyển xe khách từ Nước Ngầm, Giáp Bát về bến xe Yên Sở
evidence.summary: Hà Nội vừa thông báo đến Sở Xây dựng 17 tỉnh, thành phố phối hợp đề nghị doanh nghiệp nghiên cứu đăng ký chuyển một phần tuyến xe khách cố định từ bến xe Giáp Bát, Nước Ngầm về Yên Sở.

evidence.title: Chuyển 600 hồ sơ mua bán hoá đơn, trốn thuế sang cơ quan công an
evidence.summary: Bộ trưởng Tài chính Ngô Văn Tuấn thừa nhận tình trạng mua bán hóa đơn, trốn thuế vẫn xảy ra, và từ 2022 gần 600 hồ sơ doanh nghiệp có dấu hiệu trốn, gian lận thuế được chuyển sang cơ quan điều tra.

evidence.title: LPBank vào top 2 ngân hàng niêm yết hiệu quả 2026
evidence.summary: LPBank xếp thứ hai nhóm ngành ngân hàng trong Top 50 Công ty niêm yết kinh doanh hiệu quả nhất Việt Nam 2026, với lợi nhuận trước thuế năm 2025 đạt 14.269 tỷ đồng và ROE 25,2%.
